name: Trazodone
description: A serotonin antagonist and reuptake inhibitor approved for major depressive disorder. Low-dose use for insomnia, exploiting its antihistaminergic and alpha-1 blocking sedation, is off-label and very common.

systems.note: Serotonergic and antihistaminergic action; sedation at low dose is the reason for off-label sleep use.
Hepatic injury including rare acute liver failure is documented.
QT prolongation and orthostatic hypotension are labelled.
Priapism is a labelled and characteristic adverse effect.
Hyponatraemia is labelled for serotonergic agents.

monitors.why: Documented hepatic injury including rare acute liver failure.
